sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份后，这起离奇的谋杀案反而变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: In late 2019, bank examiner Emery Wilson was settling into his new home on South Waverley
sentences.zh: 2019年底，银行审查员埃默里·威尔逊（Emery Wilson）刚搬进位于德克萨斯州达拉斯市南韦弗利大道的新家，

sentences.en: Drive in Dallas, Texas, when he was approached by a middle-aged man and woman.
sentences.zh: 就有一对中年夫妇登门拜访。

sentences.en: They introduced themselves as married couple Jamie and Jennifer Faith.
sentences.zh: 他们自我介绍说是一对夫妻，名叫杰米（Jamie）和詹妮弗·费斯（Jennifer Faith）。

sentences.en: The Faiths lived five doors down and had arrived to give Emery a gift to warmly welcome him to their neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 费斯夫妇住在隔了五户人家的地方，他们特意过来送上一份礼物，热烈欢迎埃默里搬进这个社区。

sentences.en: As Emery came to learn, this friendly and courteous act was typical of the Faiths.
sentences.zh: 埃默里后来了解到，这种友好礼貌的行为正是费斯夫妇的一贯作风。

sentences.en: The two were known for genuinely caring about others and always doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 两人以真诚待人、乐于助人而闻名。

sentences.en: They even handed out the pin code to their gate so that neighbours could use their swimming pool or hot tub whenever they liked.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至把自家大门的密码告诉邻居，方便大家随时使用他们的游泳池或热水浴缸。

sentences.en: Just like everyone else who met them, Emery Wilson came to like the Faiths.
sentences.zh: 就像所有见过他们的人一样，埃默里·威尔逊也对费斯夫妇心生好感。

sentences.en: Both were highly successful in their respective careers, with Jamie a director of technology for
sentences.zh: 两人在各自的职业领域都非常成功，杰米是美国航空公司的技术总监，

sentences.en: American Airlines and Jennifer a distinguished speech therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 而詹妮弗则是一位杰出的言语治疗师。

sentences.en: They were also loving and supportive parents to their college-aged daughter.
sentences.zh: 他们还是充满爱心、给予支持的父母，有一个正值大学年龄的女儿。

sentences.en: Emery sometimes encountered the Faiths when they crossed paths while out walking their respective dogs.
sentences.zh: 埃默里有时会在遛狗时与费斯夫妇偶遇。

sentences.en: This happened more often in 2020, when the COVID-19 pandemic hit and Emery started working remotely from home.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在2020年新冠疫情爆发、埃默里开始居家远程办公后变得更加频繁。

sentences.en: He was there on the morning of Friday October 9, 2020, when all of a sudden, his quiet suburban
sentences.zh: 2020年10月9日星期五早上，他正在家中，突然间，他那安静的郊区环境

sentences.en: surroundings were disrupted by multiple rapid-fire bangs, followed by blood-curdling screaMs.
sentences.zh: 被几声急促的枪响打破，紧接着传来了令人毛骨悚然的尖叫声。

sentences.en: Immediately recognising the bangs as gunshots, Emery Wilson dropped to the floor and moved away from the windows.
sentences.zh: 埃默里·威尔逊立刻意识到那是枪声，他迅速趴到地板上，远离窗户。

sentences.en: The sound was out of place in the otherwise peaceful and family-oriented neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 在这个原本宁静、以家庭为重的社区里，这种声音显得格格不入。

sentences.en: Emery could hear a woman screaming in abject terror until she managed to form the words, help me, help me.
sentences.zh: 埃默里能听到一个女人在极度恐惧中尖叫，直到她勉强喊出“救命，救命”。

sentences.en: Realising someone was still in danger, Emery rushed outside.
sentences.zh: 意识到有人仍处于危险之中，埃默里冲了出去。

sentences.en: A large Bernese mountain dog was running freely in the road, with its lead trailing behind.
sentences.zh: 一只大型伯恩山犬正在路上自由奔跑，牵引绳拖在身后。

sentences.en: Emery recognised it as Jamie and Jennifer Faith's beloved dog, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 埃默里认出那是杰米和詹妮弗·费斯心爱的狗，玛吉（Maggie）。

sentences.en: Emery peered out from behind a wall in the direction of the screaming and called out, what happened?
sentences.zh: 埃默里从墙后探出头，朝着尖叫声传来的方向喊道：“发生什么事了？”

sentences.en: He couldn't see anything, so he cautiously moved across his lawn to the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 他什么也看不见，于是小心翼翼地穿过草坪来到人行道上。

sentences.en: From there, he could see a pair of legs sprawled out on the street near the Faith's residence.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他看到费斯家住宅附近的街道上横卧着一双腿。

sentences.en: Other curious neighbours had emerged from their homes.
sentences.zh: 其他好奇的邻居也从家里走了出来。

sentences.en: Emery yelled at them, call the police.
sentences.zh: 埃默里对他们大喊：“快报警！”

sentences.en: Emery raced towards the body to render assistance, only to be stopped in his tracks just two houses down.
sentences.zh: 埃默里冲向尸体试图提供帮助，但在两户人家外就被迫停下了脚步。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a male figure stepped onto the sidewalk a few feet ahead.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个男性身影出现在前方几英尺的人行道上。

sentences.en: The man turned and looked at Emery.
sentences.zh: 那人转过身看向埃默里。

sentences.en: He had the hood of his jacket pulled down over his forehead and a blue fabric face mask covered the lower half of his face.
sentences.zh: 他把夹克的兜帽拉低遮住前额，脸上戴着一个蓝色布口罩，遮住了下半张脸。

sentences.en: Emery briefly locked eyes with the man before noticing that he was clutching a silver handgun at his right side.
sentences.zh: 埃默里与那人短暂对视，随即注意到他右手紧握着一把银色手枪。

sentences.en: Panicked, Emery sprinted back to his house to collect his own firearm.
sentences.zh: 惊慌失措的埃默里冲回屋里去拿自己的枪。

sentences.en: He re-emerged, ready for a confrontation, but the gunman was gone.
sentences.zh: 当他再次出来准备对峙时，枪手已经不见了。

sentences.en: Emery realised that the body sprawled out on the street was that of 49-year-old Jamie Faith.
sentences.zh: 埃默里意识到横卧在街上的尸体是49岁的杰米·费斯。

sentences.en: He lay unmoving near the sidewalk in a growing pool of blood, clearly deceased.
sentences.zh: 他一动不动地躺在人行道旁，身下是一滩不断扩大的血泊，显然已经死亡。

sentences.en: Emery found Jamie's 48-year-old wife, Jennifer, sheltering behind a fence in a neighbour's driveway.
sentences.zh: 埃默里发现杰米48岁的妻子詹妮弗正躲在邻居家车道的一道栅栏后。

sentences.en: She was hysterical and clearly terrified, repeating,
sentences.zh: 她歇斯底里，显然被吓坏了，不停地重复着：

sentences.en: No one came.
sentences.zh: “没人来。”

sentences.en: No one came.
sentences.zh: “没人来。”

sentences.en: Emery reassured her that police were on their way, saying soothingly,
sentences.zh: 埃默里安慰她警察正在赶来，轻声说道：

sentences.en: We're here.
sentences.zh: “我们在这儿。”

sentences.en: Officers arrived within minutes to find South Waverley Drive in a state of chaos, with Jamie Faith's lifeless body at the centre.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，警察赶到，发现南韦弗利大道一片混乱，杰米·费斯的遗体横陈在路中央。

sentences.en: His wife Jennifer was visibly distraught and in a state of shock.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子詹妮弗明显心烦意乱，处于休克状态。

sentences.en: While she struggled to convey what had happened, officers ascertained that the Faiths had left their home at around 7.30am to take their dog Maggie on her daily walk.
sentences.zh: 虽然她努力想说清楚发生了什么，但警方确认费斯夫妇是在早上7点30分左右出门遛狗的。

sentences.en: They'd barely left the driveway when someone ran up behind them and began shooting without saying a word.
sentences.zh: 他们刚离开车道，就有人从背后冲上来，一言不发地开始射击。

sentences.en: Jamie was hit several times before falling to the ground.
sentences.zh: 杰米身中数枪，倒在地上。

sentences.en: The offender then stood over Jamie and fired more rounds into his body before turning his attention to Jennifer as she attempted to flee.
sentences.zh: 凶手随后站在杰米上方，又向他的身体补了几枪，然后转向试图逃跑的詹妮弗。

sentences.en: According to Jennifer, one witness had seen the shooter aim his gun at her and pull the trigger, only to realise it was out of bullets.
sentences.zh: 据詹妮弗称，有一位目击者看到枪手将枪对准她并扣动了扳机，却发现子弹打光了。

sentences.en: The shooter then sprinted after Jennifer, tackled her to the ground and unleashed a violent attack.
sentences.zh: 枪手随即追上詹妮弗，将她扑倒在地，并展开了暴力袭击。

sentences.en: Between punches, he managed to duct tape Jennifer's hands together and attempted to pull off her wedding ring.
sentences.zh: 在殴打的过程中，他设法用胶带绑住了詹妮弗的双手，并试图摘下她的结婚戒指。

sentences.en: By this point,
sentences.zh: 就在这时，

sentences.en: Jennifer's screams had alerted her neighbours, prompting the gunman to flee empty-handed.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的尖叫声惊动了邻居，迫使枪手空手逃离。

sentences.en: Because the duct tape was cut into two small lengths,
sentences.zh: 由于胶带被剪成了两小段，

sentences.en: Jennifer was able to free herself rather easily and to take shelter.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗得以比较轻松地挣脱并躲避起来。

sentences.en: Other than some minor bumps, bruises and scrapes, she was mostly unhurt.
sentences.zh: 除了些许轻微的磕碰、淤青和擦伤，她基本没有受伤。

sentences.en: Her wedding ring remained stuck halfway down her finger.
sentences.zh: 她的结婚戒指依然卡在手指中间。

sentences.en: Jamie's wedding ring was missing.
sentences.zh: 杰米的结婚戒指不见了。

sentences.en: While several people had observed the attacker from a distance, only Jennifer and her neighbour Emery Wilson had seen him up close.
sentences.zh: 虽然有几个人从远处观察到了袭击者，但只有詹妮弗和邻居埃默里·威尔逊近距离看到了他。

sentences.en: Their descriptions were limited, as his face had been mostly covered up, but both Jennifer and Emery said the offender was a dark-eyed male of medium build,
sentences.zh: 由于他的脸大部分被遮住，他们的描述很有限，但詹妮弗和埃默里都说袭击者是一名中等身材、深色眼睛的男性，

sentences.en: wearing a dark-coloured hoodie and baggy blue jeans.
sentences.zh: 穿着深色连帽衫和宽松的蓝色牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Jennifer believed he was a black man, though Emery couldn't be certain and didn't want to speculate.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗认为他是一名黑人，但埃默里无法确定，也不想妄加猜测。

sentences.en: Multiple .45-caliber bullet casings littered the street around Jamie Faith's body.
sentences.zh: 杰米·费斯尸体周围的街道上散落着多个.45口径的弹壳。

sentences.en: When the gun was fired, it produced unique imprints on the casings that couldn't be linked to a firearm used in any other known crimes.
sentences.zh: 枪支发射时在弹壳上留下了独特的印记，这些印记无法与任何其他已知犯罪中使用的枪支关联起来。

sentences.en: The pieces of duct tape used to restrain Jennifer were curled up on the driveway near Jamie's body.
sentences.zh: 用于捆绑詹妮弗的胶带碎片蜷缩在杰米尸体附近的车道上。

sentences.en: A matching roll of duct tape was found on the rooftop of the adjacent house, indicating the assailant had tossed it there.
sentences.zh: 在隔壁房子的屋顶上发现了一卷配套的胶带，表明袭击者把它扔到了那里。

sentences.en: No worthwhile forensics were uncovered on any of these iteMs.
sentences.zh: 在这些物品上没有发现任何有价值的法医证据。

sentences.en: A quick-thinking local had used their cell phone to capture a photograph of the suspect's vehicle as it fled the scene.
sentences.zh: 一名机智的当地居民用手机拍下了嫌疑人逃离现场时所驾驶车辆的照片。

sentences.en: It was a black 2004 Nissan Titan pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆黑色的2004年款日产泰坦（Nissan Titan）皮卡车。

sentences.en: Although its licence plate wasn't visible in the blurry image, a white sticker of the letter T was spotted in the corner of the rear windshield.
sentences.zh: 虽然在模糊的照片中看不清车牌，但在后挡风玻璃的角落里发现了一个白色的“T”字贴纸。

sentences.en: It appeared to be the emblem of the Texas Rangers baseball team, hinting that the vehicle's owner was local to the state.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是德克萨斯游骑兵棒球队的标志，暗示车主是该州本地人。

sentences.en: Witnesses who saw the vehicle flee were struck by how slow it moved, as though the driver wasn't in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 看到车辆逃离的目击者对它行驶缓慢的速度感到惊讶，仿佛司机并不着急。

sentences.en: Security camera footage obtained from residences and businesses throughout the area allowed detectives to track the pickup truck in the direct aftermath of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 从该地区住宅和企业获取的安全摄像头录像，让侦探们得以追踪到枪击事件发生后皮卡车的去向。

sentences.en: After leaving South Waverley Drive, the vehicle was filmed driving normally through traffic before entering the Interstate 35 Highway,
sentences.zh: 离开南韦弗利大道后，该车被拍到在车流中正常行驶，随后进入了35号州际公路，

sentences.en: which stretches northward through multiple US states.
sentences.zh: 这条公路向北延伸，穿过美国多个州。

sentences.en: It vanished from there, its licence plate still unclear.
sentences.zh: 它从那里消失了，车牌依然无法辨认。

sentences.en: Of all the houses along South Waverley Drive that had working exterior cameras, none had captured the shooting or the assailant,
sentences.zh: 在南韦弗利大道所有装有正常工作监控摄像头的住宅中，没有一家拍到枪击过程或袭击者，

sentences.en: only the sounds of gunfire and Jennifer's screaming.
sentences.zh: 只录到了枪声和詹妮弗的尖叫声。

sentences.en: The Faiths had several motion sensor cameras on their property, including one at their front door.
sentences.zh: 费斯夫妇在房产周围装有几个运动传感器摄像头，包括前门的一个。

sentences.en: This camera captured Jennifer just seconds before the confrontation as she exited the house holding Maggie by the leash, with Jamie trailing close behind.
sentences.zh: 这个摄像头拍到了对峙发生前几秒钟的詹妮弗，她牵着玛吉走出家门，杰米紧随其后。

sentences.en: The couple had a second camera positioned towards the street, but it wasn't working at the time.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇还有一个对着街道的摄像头，但当时没在工作。

sentences.en: They did, however, have a functioning camera that captured part of the neighbouring property's backyard.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们确实有一个正常工作的摄像头，拍到了邻居房产后院的一部分。

sentences.en: Nobody lived in the house, yet five hours before the shooting, at around 2.30am, the Faiths' camera recorded a figure moving around the rear of the empty property.
sentences.zh: 那栋房子没人住，但在枪击发生前五个小时，即凌晨2点30分左右，费斯家的摄像头记录到一个身影在空房子的后方走动。

sentences.en: The footage was dark and blurry, but the figure appeared to be a man wearing jeans, a dark top, and a blue mask.
sentences.zh: 录像很暗且模糊，但那个身影看起来像是一个穿着牛仔裤、深色上衣和蓝色口罩的男人。

sentences.en: He crept along the side of the house towards the street, before disappearing from view.
sentences.zh: 他沿着房子侧面悄悄走向街道，随后消失在视野中。

sentences.en: When shown the footage,
sentences.zh: 当看到这段录像时，

sentences.en: Jennifer Faith didn't recognise the figure, but she'd heard rumours about a local man who was known to wander around at night whenever he fought with his wife.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·费斯认不出那个身影，但她听说过当地有个男人，据说每次跟妻子吵架后就会在晚上四处游荡。

sentences.en: Investigators were nevertheless suspicious.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，调查人员仍感到怀疑。

sentences.en: If the figure was Jamie Faith's killer, it meant he was loitering at the crime scene hours before the shooting.
sentences.zh: 如果那个身影就是杰米·费斯的凶手，这意味着他在枪击发生前几个小时就一直在犯罪现场徘徊。

sentences.en: Given that the Faiths were confronted as they began their morning walk, it seemed as though they were targeted by someone who was familiar with their daily routine.
sentences.zh: 考虑到费斯夫妇是在开始晨练时遭遇袭击的，这看起来像是被熟悉他们日常作息的人盯上了。

sentences.en: This behaviour didn't correlate with an opportunistic robbery gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 这种行为与随机抢劫未遂不符。

sentences.en: It felt remarkably calculated, like an ambush.
sentences.zh: 这感觉非常蓄意，就像一场伏击。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed that Jamie had been shot a total of seven times.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，杰米总共身中七枪。

sentences.en: He was felled by three initial shots to the chest, then struck thrice more point-blank in the head.
sentences.zh: 他先是被三枪击中胸部倒地，随后头部又被近距离补了三枪。

sentences.en: Notably, the seventh and final shot was aimed at Jamie's groin.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，第七枪也是最后一枪，瞄准的是杰米的腹股沟。

sentences.en: The chest wounds were enough to incapacitate Jamie and the first headshot killed him instantly, which led investigators to question why the killer continued shooting.
sentences.zh: 胸部的伤足以让杰米丧失行动能力，第一枪爆头就让他当场毙命，这让调查人员质疑凶手为何还要继续射击。

sentences.en: This level of overkill was uncharacteristic of a bungled robbery.
sentences.zh: 这种程度的过度杀戮并非拙劣抢劫的特征。

sentences.en: Each shot was deliberate and accurate, clearly performed by someone who had experience using firearMs.
sentences.zh: 每一枪都经过深思熟虑且精准无比，显然是受过枪械使用训练的人所为。

sentences.en: The shot to Jamie's groin was highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 瞄准杰米腹股沟的那一枪非常反常。

sentences.en: Intentional wounds to genitalia typically indicated the attack had sexual connotations.
sentences.zh: 对生殖器部位的蓄意伤害通常意味着袭击具有性暗示。

sentences.en: This, coupled with the fact that Jennifer had come away from the deadly encounter relatively unscathed,
sentences.zh: 这一点，加上詹妮弗在致命袭击中相对毫发无损的事实，

sentences.en: suggested that her husband was the sole target.
sentences.zh: 表明她的丈夫才是唯一的目标。

sentences.en: Investigators began digging through
sentences.zh: 调查人员开始深挖

sentences.en: Jamie Faith's life, looking for anyone who would want to harm him.
sentences.zh: 杰米·费斯的生活，寻找任何可能想伤害他的人。

sentences.en: By all accounts,
sentences.zh: 据各方说法，

sentences.en: Jamie was a well-liked and peaceful person who lived a normal life.
sentences.zh: 杰米是一个广受好评、性格平和的人，过着正常的生活。

sentences.en: He enjoyed playing video games, billiards and bowling, and was a big fan of the Green Bay Packers football team.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢玩电子游戏、打台球和保龄球，还是绿湾包装工橄榄球队的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: Those closest to Jamie described him as smart, resourceful, quirky and always happy.
sentences.zh: 与杰米最亲近的人形容他聪明、机智、古怪且总是很快乐。

sentences.en: With a penchant for button-up Hawaiian shirts and a love for all things wine, food and travel,

sentences.en: She admitted that she and Darren had recently been in contact and were caught up in old emotions, but she said she'd put an end to anything romantic in August 2020.
sentences.zh: 她承认她和达伦最近确实有联系，并且陷入了旧情之中，但她说她在2020年8月就已经结束了任何浪漫关系。

sentences.en: Since then, Jennifer said they were just friends and claimed she was helping Darren navigate through tough times.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗说，从那以后他们只是朋友，并声称她是在帮助达伦度过难关。

sentences.en: The interviewing detective said,
sentences.zh: 讯问的侦探说：

sentences.en: The same guy that killed your husband is the same guy that you're communicating with every day.
sentences.zh: “杀了你丈夫的那个人，和你每天都在联系的人是同一个。”

sentences.en: How could you talk to somebody that killed your husband?
sentences.zh: “你怎么能和一个杀了你丈夫的人交谈呢？”

sentences.en: The fact that Jennifer had led the police to so many dead ends made them suspect that she was lying to protect Darren.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗引导警方走了这么多死胡同，这让他们怀疑她是在撒谎保护达伦。

sentences.en: What they couldn't figure out was why she didn't just leave Jamie if she no longer wanted to be with him.
sentences.zh: 他们想不通的是，如果她不想再和杰米在一起，为什么不直接离开他？

sentences.en: Why did he have to die?
sentences.zh: 为什么他非死不可？

sentences.en: When presented with this question, Jennifer stopped talking and asked for an attorney.
sentences.zh: 当被问到这个问题时，詹妮弗停止了交谈，并要求请律师。

sentences.en: Jennifer's assertions highlighted a major issue in the unravelling case.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的断言凸显了这起扑朔迷离案件中的一个重大问题。

sentences.en: Despite everything that had been uncovered so far,
sentences.zh: 尽管目前已经揭露了一切，

sentences.en: investigators still hadn't found any evidence of Jennifer scheming with Darren to remove Jamie from the picture or encouraging him to kill.
sentences.zh: 调查人员仍然没有找到任何证据表明詹妮弗曾与达伦密谋除掉杰米，或怂恿他杀人。

sentences.en: Just because the two had remained in contact after Jamie was killed, it didn't prove Jennifer was involved in the crime.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为两人在杰米被杀后仍保持联系，并不能证明詹妮弗参与了犯罪。

sentences.en: The question therefore remained as to what role, if any, she played in her husband's murder.
sentences.zh: 因此，她在丈夫谋杀案中究竟扮演了什么角色（如果有的话），仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: Investigators hoped that the answers would be found in Darren's cell phone, which they had swiftly confiscated upon his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 调查人员希望能在达伦的手机里找到答案，他们在达伦被捕后迅速没收了这台手机。

sentences.en: Despite leaving him with no time to interact with the device, it appeared to have already been wiped clean of any of his communications with the Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 尽管没给他时间操作设备，但手机里似乎已经清除了他与詹妮弗的所有通讯记录。

sentences.en: It was assumed that Darren had performed a factory reset, but a data extraction was conducted regardless.
sentences.zh: 人们推测达伦执行了恢复出厂设置，但警方还是进行了数据提取。

sentences.en: It turned out that Darren wasn't particularly tech-savvy.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，达伦并不是特别精通技术。

sentences.en: While he had managed to permanently delete most of his text message history with the Jennifer, he had failed to completely erase all the data.
sentences.zh: 虽然他成功永久删除了大部分与詹妮弗的短信记录，但他没能彻底抹除所有数据。

sentences.en: Despite Darren and Jennifer's claims of a platonic friendship, the recovered texts revealed that their relationship was indeed intimate.
sentences.zh: 尽管达伦和詹妮弗声称只是柏拉图式的友谊，但恢复的短信显示他们的关系确实很亲密。

sentences.en: Darren texted Jennifer things like,
sentences.zh: 达伦给詹妮弗发短信说：

sentences.en: I am so in love with you, to which she responded,
sentences.zh: “我太爱你了，”她回复道：

sentences.en: I truly can't be without you at this point.
sentences.zh: “事到如今，我真的离不开你了。”

sentences.en: Jennifer suggested that she move in with Darren, which he thought was a great idea.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗建议搬去和达伦一起住，达伦觉得这是个好主意。

sentences.en: The pair also engaged in many explicit sexual conversations, both before and after Jamie's murder.
sentences.zh: 两人在杰米遇害前后还进行了许多露骨的性对话。

sentences.en: Some were extreme, centering around topics like dominance, submission, bondage, voyeurism, and even rape.
sentences.zh: 有些内容非常极端，围绕着支配、服从、捆绑、偷窥甚至强奸等话题。

sentences.en: The most compelling messages were in relation to the ongoing investigation into Jamie's murder.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的信息与杰米谋杀案的调查进展有关。

sentences.en: After Jennifer made a public appeal to find the suspect's vehicle, she texted Darren.
sentences.zh: 在詹妮弗公开呼吁寻找嫌疑人车辆后，她给达伦发了短信。

sentences.en: So, I woke up in a little bit of a panic.
sentences.zh: “我醒来时有点恐慌。”

sentences.en: Something is eating away at me, telling me you need to take the sticker out of the back window of the truck.
sentences.zh: “有些事一直折磨着我，我觉得你必须把卡车后窗上的贴纸撕掉。”

sentences.en: It might just be me overthinking or something, but I'll feel a ton better if you take it off and clean the window really well.
sentences.zh: “可能是我多虑了，但如果你把它撕掉并把窗户擦干净，我会感觉好受得多。”

sentences.en: Darren assured Jennifer that he would take care of it.
sentences.zh: 达伦向詹妮弗保证他会处理好。

sentences.en: But by the next day, she was increasingly anxious.
sentences.zh: 但到了第二天，她变得越来越焦虑。

sentences.en: I know you're going to think I'm crazy, she messaged to Darren.
sentences.zh: “我知道你会觉得我疯了，”她给达伦发信息说。

sentences.en: But it's really nagging at me.
sentences.zh: “但这真的让我很不安。”

sentences.en: I have a bad feeling and I really think you need to get that sticker off ASAP.
sentences.zh: “我有种不好的预感，我觉得你必须尽快把那张贴纸弄掉。”

sentences.en: Like, today.
sentences.zh: “比如，今天。”

sentences.en: He later messaged her,
sentences.zh: 他后来给她发信息说：

sentences.en: Sticker done.
sentences.zh: “贴纸搞定了。”

sentences.en: Jennifer replied,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗回复道：

sentences.en: In other messages, Jennifer told Darren that if the police ever asked about her, he should say they were old friends.
sentences.zh: 在其他信息中，詹妮弗告诉达伦，如果警察问起她，就说他们是老朋友。

sentences.en: They were only speaking daily because Jennifer was giving him advice as he went through a difficult divorce.
sentences.zh: 他们每天通话只是因为詹妮弗在给正经历艰难离婚的达伦提供建议。

sentences.en: She told Darren to say that as far as he knew, her marriage to Jamie was a happy one.
sentences.zh: 她告诉达伦，就他所知，她和杰米的婚姻很幸福。

sentences.en: She also added Darren to the private group text message thread that she used to keep her close friends and family updated on her husband's case.
sentences.zh: 她还将达伦拉进了她用来向密友和家人通报丈夫案件进展的私人群聊中。

sentences.en: At one stage, she complained to Darren about having to do a press interview as Jamie's bereaved widow, saying,
sentences.zh: 有一次，她向达伦抱怨作为杰米的遗孀不得不接受媒体采访，她说：

sentences.en: The reporter sucked, but I did fine.
sentences.zh: “那个记者烂透了，但我表现得很好。”

sentences.en: He insisted on having me look at a stupid photo book of Jamie at the end.
sentences.zh: “最后他非要让我看一本杰米的蠢相册。”

sentences.en: Barf.
sentences.zh: “真恶心。”

sentences.en: On multiple occasions, Jennifer told Darren she was clearing her phone by doing a factory reset and she instructed him to do the same.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗多次告诉达伦她正在通过恢复出厂设置来清理手机，并指示他也这样做。

sentences.en: When Darren thought he had done so, Jennifer replied,
sentences.zh: 当达伦以为自己做到了时，詹妮弗回复道：

sentences.en: Big smile over here at that.
sentences.zh: “这儿有个大大的微笑。”

sentences.en: At one point, Jennifer and Darren discussed Jamie's life insurance policy, which was worth over $600,000.
sentences.zh: 有一次，詹妮弗和达伦讨论了杰米价值超过60万美元的人寿保险单。

sentences.en: Jennifer was the sole beneficiary, while Jamie also had a further $400,000 in a retirement account.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗是唯一的受益人，此外杰米还有一个40万美元的退休账户。

sentences.en: A month after Jamie's murder, Jennifer had attempted to collect some of the money, but she was denied.
sentences.zh: 杰米遇害一个月后，詹妮弗试图领取部分钱款，但被拒绝了。

sentences.en: She vented about it in a text to Darren, saying, They aren't processing the claim yet because the detectives told them I couldn't be ruled out as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 她在给达伦的短信中发泄不满，说：“他们还没处理索赔，因为侦探告诉他们我不能排除嫌疑。”

sentences.en: So I called them and basically said,
sentences.zh: “所以我打电话给他们，基本上就是说：”

sentences.en: What the fuck?
sentences.zh: “搞什么鬼？”

sentences.en: Jennifer was also the sole beneficiary of the $60,000 in donations collected via the online fundraiser for Jamie's funeral services.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗还是通过在线筹款活动为杰米葬礼筹集的6万美元捐款的唯一受益人。

sentences.en: She began with the drawing from these funds almost immediately.
sentences.zh: 她几乎立刻就开始动用这笔钱。

sentences.en: Within four days, she had taken out over $30,000, and within weeks, there was nothing left.
sentences.zh: 四天内，她取走了超过3万美元，几周内就所剩无几了。

sentences.en: The two memorial services for Jamie had only cost to Jennifer $6,000, which she hadn't even paid.
sentences.zh: 杰米的两次追悼会只花了詹妮弗6000美元，而且她甚至还没付钱。

sentences.en: Credit reports reflected that by 2020, Darren Lopez was having severe financial probleMs.
sentences.zh: 信用报告显示，到2020年，达伦·洛佩兹正面临严重的财务问题。

sentences.en: He was at least 120 days past due on mortgage payments totaling over $38,000, and foreclosure had been initiated.
sentences.zh: 他的抵押贷款逾期至少120天，总额超过3.8万美元，银行已启动止赎程序。

sentences.en: In October, failure to pay his water bills resulted in the water to his house being shut off.
sentences.zh: 10月份，由于未付水费，他家被停水了。

sentences.en: Online records showed that Jennifer had transferred large amounts of money to Darren after Jamie's murder.
sentences.zh: 在线记录显示，杰米遇害后，詹妮弗曾向达伦转账大笔资金。

sentences.en: She had also bought him the new television, airline tickets, and had granted him access to her credit cards, texting,
sentences.zh: 她还给他买了新电视、机票，并让他使用自己的信用卡，发短信说：

sentences.en: Please don't hesitate to use them for whatever you need.
sentences.zh: “请尽管用它们买你需要的东西。”

sentences.en: Jennifer used the money fundraised on her behalf to help pay back over $100,000 that she and Darren had spent on the credit card.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗利用为她筹集的资金来偿还她和达伦在信用卡上花费的超过10万美元的债务。

sentences.en: She told Darren that if detectives ever asked why Jennifer was giving him money, he should say that she was supporting him through his financial hardship.
sentences.zh: 她告诉达伦，如果侦探问起为什么她要给他钱，就说她在帮他度过财务难关。

sentences.en: I'll answer the same way, she texted him, just so you and I have the same explanations.
sentences.zh: “我会给出同样的回答，”她发短信给他，“这样我们俩的解释就一致了。”

sentences.en: Darren responded,
sentences.zh: 达伦回复道：

sentences.en: I like it.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢这个主意。”

sentences.en: With this evidence coming to light, investigators suspected that Jennifer had hired Darren to kill her husband.
sentences.zh: 随着这些证据浮出水面，调查人员怀疑詹妮弗雇佣了达伦来杀害她的丈夫。

sentences.en: Given Darren's elite military training, not only was he the ideal hitman, he also had the financial and romantic motives to do so.
sentences.zh: 鉴于达伦受过精英军事训练，他不仅是理想的杀手，还有财务和情感上的动机去这样做。

sentences.en: But with no admissions from either party and no concrete evidence to prove it, it remained pure speculation.
sentences.zh: 但由于双方都没有认罪，也没有确凿证据证明这一点，这仍然纯属猜测。

sentences.en: What was abundantly clear was that Jennifer Faith's private persona was very different from the grieving widow she portrayed in public.
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，詹妮弗·费斯的私人形象与她在公众面前表现出的悲痛遗孀形象大相径庭。

sentences.en: In reality, she was careful and cunning.
sentences.zh: 实际上，她既谨慎又狡猾。

sentences.en: She asserted that she had no idea who killed her husband, while keeping the man she was having an emotional affair with secret from investigators.
sentences.zh: 她声称不知道是谁杀了她丈夫，同时对调查人员隐瞒了她与其有婚外情的事实。

sentences.en: She lied to her friend about ending things with Darren when she was still messaging him excessively.
sentences.zh: 她对朋友撒谎说已经和达伦断绝了关系，而实际上她仍在频繁地给他发信息。

sentences.en: She provided false information and dead-end leads to misdirect the police and public.
sentences.zh: 她提供虚假信息和死胡同线索，以误导警方和公众。

sentences.en: She coached Darren on how to respond to police questions and instigated the destruction of crucial evidence.
sentences.zh: 她指导达伦如何应对警方盘问，并指使他销毁关键证据。

sentences.en: Investigators viewed Jennifer's conduct and corrupt actions as a calculated attempt to obstruct the criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为詹妮弗的行为和腐败举动是阻碍刑事调查的蓄意企图。

sentences.en: As a result, she was charged with obstruction of justice, to which she pleaded not guilty.
sentences.zh: 因此，她被控妨碍司法公正，她对此表示不认罪。

sentences.en: Given that authorities still didn't have anything to prove
sentences.zh: 鉴于当局仍然没有任何证据证明

sentences.en: Jennifer was complicit in her husband's murder, she was released pending further investigations.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗是她丈夫谋杀案的同谋，她在等待进一步调查期间被释放。

sentences.en: With suspicions cast squarely on her, detectives were curious to see her next move.
sentences.zh: 由于怀疑的目光直接投向她，侦探们很想看看她的下一步行动。

sentences.en: They knew there was still more to uncover, but felt confident they were about to close the case.
sentences.zh: 他们知道还有更多内情有待挖掘，但相信他们即将结案。

sentences.en: The situation appeared to be a sordid love triangle with fatal consequences, which was nothing that they hadn't seen before.
sentences.zh: 这种情况似乎是一个有着致命后果的肮脏三角恋，这在他们看来并不陌生。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Darren Lopez was charged with the murder of Jamie Faith, as well as transporting a firearm in interstate commerce.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，达伦·洛佩兹被控谋杀杰米·费斯，以及跨州运输枪支罪。

sentences.en: Case detectives were lauded for their dedicated and meticulous police work, with the chief of the Dallas Police Department saying,
sentences.zh: 案件侦探因其敬业和细致的警务工作受到赞扬，达拉斯警察局局长表示：

sentences.en: I am pleased to see that there were no stones left unturned during the course of this investigation, and that our collaborative efforts have brought those involved to justice.
sentences.zh: “我很高兴看到在这次调查过程中没有放过任何蛛丝马迹，我们的协作努力已将涉案人员绳之以法。”

sentences.en: Darren Lopez pleaded not guilty and was remanded in custody to await his trial.
sentences.zh: 达伦·洛佩兹表示不认罪，并被还押候审。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Jennifer Faith asked a third party to forward a message onto Darren in jail.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，詹妮弗·费斯要求第三方转达一条信息给狱中的达伦。

sentences.en: Aware that all their communications would be monitored,
sentences.zh: 意识到他们所有的通讯都会受到监控，

sentences.en: Jennifer just wanted Darren to know that she was with him and would always be with him, no matter what had happened.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗只是想让达伦知道，无论发生了什么，她都和他在一起，并将永远和他在一起。

sentences.en: It was an intriguing comment that seemed to support Jennifer's claims that she didn't know the full extent of Darren's actions.
sentences.zh: 这是一个耐人寻味的评论，似乎支持了詹妮弗关于她不知道达伦行为全部程度的说法。

sentences.en: Yet, she remained unfazed and fully committed to him even though he was charged with Jamie's murder.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管达伦被控谋杀杰米，她依然泰然自若，对他全心全意。

sentences.en: Jennifer told her messenger,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗告诉传话人：

sentences.en: Darren responded to Jennifer via the messenger, saying,
sentences.zh: 达伦通过传话人回复詹妮弗说：

sentences.en: Please stay strong for us.
sentences.zh: “请为我们坚强起来。”

sentences.en: He referred to himself as her knight, a noble and chivalrous warrior charged with protecting her.
sentences.zh: 他称自己为她的骑士，一位肩负保护她使命的高尚而勇敢的战士。

sentences.en: As Darren's trial loomed, his ex-wife began taking care of several financial matters on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 随着达伦的审判临近，他的前妻开始代表他处理一些财务事宜。

sentences.en: In order to do this, Darren gave her access to his email account.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，达伦给了她访问自己电子邮箱的权限。

sentences.en: As she navigated his inbox, she came across something shocking.
sentences.zh: 当她浏览他的收件箱时，她发现了令人震惊的事情。

sentences.en: To be continued, next week.
sentences.zh: 下周继续。

sentences.zh: 下周继续。
